Class Host

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.users.User
york.studentevents.users.Host
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEntity, IHost, IUser
public class Host extends User implements IHost
Represents a Host user of the platform, including their profile details, and hosted events.

    • Host

      public Host(String username, String email, Set<UUID> hostedEvents)
      Creates a Host with the given details.
      Parameters:
      username - the user's username; must not be null, blank, or empty.
      email - the user's email; must not be null, blank, or empty.
      hostedEvents - the events hosted by the user; no validation is performed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the username or email is invalid
